icons.name: bell
icons.description: A gently squared bell with a separate hanging clapper.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Original bell shoulder curve transitions into nearly vertical walls. Broad lower lip balances the narrow crown.

icons.name: camera
icons.description: A compact camera with a continuous curved body and circular lens.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Original Bézier body: shoulders taper into a raised shutter housing; lens is optically lowered to 12.9.

icons.name: folder
icons.description: A rounded folder silhouette with a distinct tab and a straight movable front-panel edge.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Original rounded rectangular outer contour preserves the folder tab and is drawn once. The front-panel upper edge is a single straight horizontal stroke at y=10, meeting the side walls without retracing the sides or bottom. Lower corners use matching 2.5-unit construction for balanced spacing. The existing named body/lid parts, stroke defaults and motion recipe are retained; only geometry is revised for static review.

icons.name: heart
icons.description: A balanced heart with full lobes and a softened lower point.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Original symmetric lobes with a shallow notch and curved lower point; no rounded-square frame.

icons.name: search
icons.description: A clear circular search lens with a short angled handle.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Original construction from a circle centered at 10.4 and a 45-degree handle. Circular geometry preserves immediate recognition.

icons.name: settings
icons.description: A six-tooth gear with flowing shoulders and a circular center.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Original six-tooth outline with Bézier shoulders. The gear stays recognizable rather than forcing a squircle silhouette.
